From: karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com

Hi Maria,

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Attached is our AP onboarding packet (RI_AP_Onboarding_Packet.pdf) and a prefilled sample invoice (invoice_template.xlsx). Answers inline below.

- EDI: We currently support PDF and CSV/Excel invoices via our supplier portal and email. We are piloting EDI 810 for a small set of customers — if Silverline requires EDI now we can scope an EDI onboarding sprint but it will add ~2 weeks to the setup.

- PO / GL fields: Please ensure the PO number is placed in the field labeled "PO Number" on the invoice. For GL or cost center codes, include them in the "Customer Reference" field; our AP parser maps Customer Reference -> Accounting Notes. If you want a specific GL mapping, please send a short mapping table and we'll add it to the supplier profile.

- VAT: Redwood Inference, Inc. is US-headquartered. For EU customers we invoice net of VAT where reverse charge applies. Our standard approach:
  * If the customer provides a valid EU VAT number and indicates intra-EU B2B reverse charge, we omit VAT and include the clause: "Reverse charge applies — Article 194 (EU). Customer VAT ID: <provided>".
  * If the customer is non-VAT registered/consumer, we can add VAT to the invoice.

Please confirm Silverline's VAT ID and whether you want our invoices to state reverse charge. Our legal team requires that you include your VAT ID on the PO.

- Banking: We prefer wire to our US account for USD. For EUR wires we can accept an EU correspondent account. Bank details are in the packet and the bank letter (Redwood_Bank_Letter.pdf). If you pay via your procurement system, we can also accept payments via your virtual card — let us know which method you'll use.

Attachments: RI_AP_Onboarding_Packet.pdf, Redwood_W9.pdf, Redwood_Bank_Letter.pdf, invoice_template.xlsx

Next steps I recommend:
1) You register Redwood in your supplier portal (link if you want procurement to include us).
2) Share Silverline's VAT ID and preferred payment method.
3) If you want EDI 810, tell us which EDI provider you use and we will schedule a short tech kickoff.

Cc'ing Laura (Finance) and Neha (Sales Ops) to help with any GL mapping and contract billing terms.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Vendor Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Hi Karthik — thanks for the packet. A couple of clarifications from Procurement/IT: 

- Supplier portal: Procurement prefers to onboard via our supplier portal (link below). Oliver from Procure-Srv will send the registration invite. The portal accepts attachments (bank letter, W9) and an invoice sample.
- VAT: Silverline is VAT-registered in the UK. We will provide our VAT ID during portal registration; we will indicate reverse charge on invoices to vendors who confirm net invoicing. Please ensure the invoice includes a line: "Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the customer. Customer VAT ID: GB123456789" when applicable.
- PO referencing: Our PO format is strictly alphanumeric; the PO appears on the portal under "Order Number" and that should map to your PO Number field. The portal can also send a GL/Cost Center string in a separate XML attribute — if you'd like the mapping we can provide a sample XML export.

Oliver — can you confirm whether the portal supports CSV invoice ingestion or only PDF/PDF-converted attachments? If not, we will plan to route PDFs to Redwood's billing mailbox.

Thanks,
AP Team
Silverline Retail
